description:
As an Embedded Software Engineer – Avionics Displays (C++) here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will be responsible for a variety of professional-level engineering responsibilities and requires the application of advanced knowledge of software engineering disciplines, processes, and tools to execute project subtasks and ensure compliance with technical, quality, and customer requirements. You will contribute to the design, development, integration, verification, and release of software features for Avionics Displays systems, algorithms, and software frameworks. This position plays an important role in delivering products that meet customer specifications, certification requirements, and organizational quality standards. The role also involves regular interaction with internal stakeholders and external customers to support project execution and product compliance.

 This Embedded Software Engineer is recognized as an emerging authority within Integrated Flight Deck Systems COE and is expected to help define and improve engineering processes, recommend enhancements to technical methods, and mentor early-career engineers. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical depth, independent problem-solving ability, and the capability to lead feature decomposition, coordinate development activities, and support programs execution.  You will directly impact product delivery by executing engineering subtasks, identifying technical improvements, driving feature implementation, and supporting the successful completion of customer-driven software solutions. 

 You will report directly to our Sr Software Engineering Manager and you’ll work out of our Phoenix, AZ location on a hybrid work schedule. Note: For the first 90 days, New Hires must be prepared to work 100% onsite M-F.  

  

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 Plan and execute software engineering activities to meet technical, quality, schedule, certification, and customer requirements.

 Analyze, develop, and manage software and system requirements, feature implementation, and technical coordination across development activities.

 Design, develop, integrate, maintain, test, debug, and verify avionics display software, algorithms, and application/framework-level functionality.

 Support software build, integration, release, and delivery activities while ensuring compliance with product, project, and certification requirements.

 Collaborate with cross-functional engineering, quality, certification, program management, and customer teams to support product development and customer acceptance.

 Communicate technical progress, project status, risks, compliance findings, and corrective actions to stakeholders, leadership, and customers.

 Drive continuous improvement of engineering processes, methods, and product quality, while providing technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to engineers.

 

   YOU MUST HAVE 
 High School Diploma or GED
 Minimum 5 years of software development experience, including product development and systems/software integration in embedded, real-time, or regulated software environments.
 Minimum 5 years of hands-on development experience using C++ in embedded and/or real-time systems (e.g., DEOS, RTOS, or equivalent environments).
 Experience designing and implementing software architectures, object-oriented designs, algorithms, data structures, and software lifecycle processes including design, development, verification, and release.
  
 WE VALUE 
 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as the sciences, technology, engineering or mathematics.
 Minimum 5 years of experience developing software in regulated or safety-critical industries such as aerospace, avionics, defense, industrial automation, medical devices, or similar environments.
 Experience developing, integrating, testing, or maintaining real-time, embedded, control, or mission-critical systems.
 Experience supporting certification, compliance reviews, quality audits, or requirements-based verification activities.
 Experience providing technical guidance, code reviews, onboarding support, or mentoring to early-career engineers.
  
 U.S. PERSON REQUIREMENTS  
 Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.​ 
 We are currently not sponsoring applicants for work visas for this job. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. 
  
 BENEFITS    
 Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
 Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
 Short-term and long-term disability coverage
 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
 Employee assistance program and educational assistance
 Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
 Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time
 Explore your benefits:  https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/ 
  
 ABOUT HONEYWELL AEROSPACE  
 Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution. 
 Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.
 Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
 Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.
  
 ABOUT THE BUSINESS UNIT 
 Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board. 

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com

Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology that help aircraft perform safely and with precision. Our systems are on board 90% of the world's aircraft — serving commercial aviation, defense and space operators from integrated flight deck platforms with 30-plus years in service to radiation-hardened systems trusted for human spaceflight.
  
 The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posting Date:  11/10/2026
